attr.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
attr.desc: Clean-room BYO-data loader for The Amazing Spider-Man 2 Android 1.2.7d. Includes proven ARMHF routes plus a scoped AArch64 X5M/Box32 route, native controls and audio, persistent saves, the original first-run flow and transactional setup. Executable game data is not included.
attr.inst: Place a legally owned Android 1.2.7d APK and all three matching OBB files, loose or inside a ZIP, in asm2_127/gamedata and launch once. NXExtract validates and prepares them automatically.
